items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I made "Cindy Oh Cindy," which was a big hit... I made "Cindy, Oh Cindy" with Vince Vincent Martin.

ctx.x: Vince Martin was a folk singer. I can't remember the fellow's name; he's a movie actor now, but he was also a member of the group.
